card.name: Separators and digits inside date ranges
card.fires_on: A slash, hyphen or year digit inside a date or year range, right before the second year or number is written. Seen in citations, history texts and review dates.

modes.label: Separator between years
modes.description: A slash or dash between two years or a month and a year.

modes.label: Digit in a year range
modes.description: A digit partway through the end of a year range or a year.

modes.label: Review date separator
modes.description: The slash between month and year in a label's review date.

card.plain: It fires on the slash, dash or digit in the middle of a date or year range, just before the next year is given.
